step1.description: Discover amazing food deals from restaurants, bakeries, and grocery stores near you. Filter by distance, price, or cuisine to find your perfect meal.

step2.title: Step 2: Order and Confirm
step2.description: Select your favorite offer and order it with one tap. Confirm your order details and get ready for your delicious meal.

step3.title: Step 3: Choose Payment & Delivery
step3.description: Pay online for convenience or pay on pickup. Select online payment with delivery to get your food brought to you, or pick it up yourself.

step4.title: Step 4: Enjoy Your Delicious Food
step4.description: Save quality meals at amazing prices while making a positive impact on the environment. Every bite helps reduce food waste!

step5.description: Collect points with every order and unlock exclusive rewards. The more you save food, the more you earn!

step6.title: Step 6: Get Rewards
step6.description: Redeem your points by donating them, or keep collecting to unlock bigger rewards. Turn your food-saving efforts into real benefits.

section5.title: Looking for answers?
section5.description: Find quick answers to common questions about Too Fresh To Waste. We're here to help you save food and money with ease.

faq1.question: How does Too Fresh To Waste work?
faq1.answer: Too Fresh To Waste connects you with local restaurants, bakeries, hotels, and grocery stores that have surplus food. Browse offers near you, reserve your meal, pay securely, and pick it up at the designated time or choose home delivery. It's that simple!

faq2.question: What is the business solution?
faq2.answer:
PROFIT FROM YOUR SURPLUS FOOD

Our marketplace connects your business with users across Tunisia - all eager to buy surplus food.

faq3.question: What is the big prize?
faq3.answer: The Big Prize is a high-value reward awarded every 3-4 months to the 10 most active users in Tunisia. The prize may include phones, electric scooters, smart watches, and other valuable gifts announced before each event.

faq4.question: How do I get the big prize?
faq4.answer:
Buying surprise bags
Referring friends or businesses
Leaving honest reviews
Buying multiple bags in a short time
Logging in daily for 15 consecutive days
